title: Motion (McOsker – Nazarian) relative to requesting the Chief Legislative Analyst and City Attorney to immediately release any and all pending reports for…
text:
[Council File 24-0196-S1]
Motion (McOsker – Nazarian) relative to requesting the Chief Legislative Analyst and City Attorney to immediately release any and all pending reports for Council File 24-0196, it should include the motion’s request for policy options and code amendments to streamline matters related to the administration, enforcement, governance, implementation, and oversight of nuisance abatement proceedings as currently prescribed by the Los Angeles Municipal Code and the Los Angeles Administrative Code.
(This item is referred to the Public Works Committee and Planning and Land Use Management Committee. The Public Works Committee approved this item on September 22, 2026.)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion asking the city attorney and legislative analyst to release pending reports on streamlining nuisance abatement proceedings.

outcome.text: Planning and Land Use Management Committee approved item(s) (Oct 13, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 20, 2026)
